sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Abandoned Dungeon is a dark area beneath Ashina Castle that's being used by surgeons to conduct experiments on the inmates.
Sculptor's Idols:
- Underground Waterway
- Bottomless Hole

sections.heading: Abandoned Dungeon Entrance

sections.heading: Underground Waterway
sections.text:

sections.heading: Bottomless Hole
sections.text:
Dark caverns leading from the dungeon to a large pit home to a Shichimen Warrior. Past that, a truly bottomless hole that supposedly leads to the very depths of Ashina.
